name: IKEA: The Co-Worker
desc:
Hej! Welcome to the official IKEA Store on Roblox
Get ready to experience how careers are done differently at IKEA. 

Explore two areas within the game, move up roles, gain experience and grow your career in any direction!

Move up the ranks, gain XP and progress through your career! 🏢

THE SHOWROOM
🧹  Make the IKEA Showroom ready for customers before time runs out!
🤝  Help customers find the perfect product
🛋️  Decorate stunning room sets
🧑‍💼  Become the Interior Design Manager and lead your team to success!

THE SWEDISH BISTRO & SWEDISH MARKET
🫧  Keep the Bistro & Swedish Market clean and customer ready!
🌭  Serve and prepare food for customers!
💼  Manage your team and serve meatballs at our Swedish Bistro!

🎁 EARN 4 FREE UGCs! 🎁
